audit_2026_08_16.review: high-effort audit of all session-authored code (fork patches, control-plane, tools)
fixes: fork storage.rs: commit-path confirm_sync failure is now explicitly fail-stop (fatal_commit_durability_ambiguity) in BOTH Write and Conflict branches - durability ambiguity can only be resolved by crash recovery replaying the WAL; the previous typed-error return stranded the sequence in Validated state and wedged the watermark forever. Storage suite re-verified equal to baseline.

worker-entry: payload immutability enforced (create-or-identical PUT, 409 PAYLOAD_IMMUTABILITY_VIOLATION on overwrite) and exact reads re-verify bytes against the catalogued digest (500 PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION); E2E extended (20 checks).
procedures.ts: status-singleton dedupe moved BEFORE admission so lost-response status recovery is never blocked by budgets; node regression added (13/13).

database-controller alarm(): every pass advances next_due_at (success: +interval, failure: bounded exponential backoff), scheduleTask/armAlarm/runScheduledTask structure, dead-code catch eliminated; workerd regression added (3/3).
database-controller: ControllerCore built once per DO instantiation (schema DDL no longer on the hot path).
generate_catalog.py: --list subprocess failures now fatal unless the recognized harness=false flag rejection.
storage-diff-spike: prefix_bounds returns Option upper bound (0xFF safe); differential extended to prefix 0xFF (unbounded scan).
keyspace.rs delete: comment corrected to state POSIX-only unlink guarantee; Windows failure mode surfaces as the typed DirectoryRemove error.
